sloka: तानि दृष्ट्वा महाबाहुर्दर्शयित्वा मुहुर्मुहुः ।राघवः सहसौमित्रिः सुग्रीवे संन्यवेदयत् ।। ५.३५.४३।।।।
transliteration: tāni dṛṣṭvā mahābāhurdarśayitvā muhurmuhuḥ ।rāghavaḥ sahasaumitriḥ sugrīve saṁnyavedayat ।। 5.35.43।।।।

translations.english: "Longarmed Rama along with Lakshmana looked at them again and again and gave them to the care of Sugriva.
